responsibility: This file defines the DFA-based pipeline scheduler model for the Loongson 3A core in the MIPS backend. It declares the integer, floating-point, and memory automata and execution units, then assigns reservation latencies for arithmetic, branch, HI/LO, multiply/divide, load/store, coprocessor-transfer, floating-point arithmetic, conversion, and divide/sqrt classes keyed to cpu=loongson_3a, so GCC’s instruction scheduler can model issue choices and operation costs specifically for Loongson-3A tuning rather than using the generic or Loongson-2E/2F descriptions.
